basic_info.description: The Bristol @ Yerba Buena Island is a luxury condominium within a one-of-a-kind city meets island living experience. Residents enjoy a 72-acre natural playground complete with trails, parks, coves & quiet beaches to savor the natural beauty of the setting. The Bristol represents a rare offering where the best of the Bay Area is a bike, ferry or short car ride away. This gracious home offers 750 sq ft Studio features approximately 10' ceiling heights & floor to ceiling windows add to the open feel of this home. Kitchens are appointed w/ Arclinea Italian cabinetry, Miele appliances & Dornbrach faucets. Wide plank white oak flooring throughout & level-4 wall finish. Primary bathroom w/ carrara marble countertop & oversized walk-in shower.  Residents enjoy unprecedented amenities w/ a state-of-the-art fitness studio, a monthly calendar of fitness classes, an open air residents lounge w/ fireplace, rooftop lounge w/ BBQ, 24-hour staffed front desks & 24/7 roving security. Free shuttle service connects residents to the YBI/TI ferry w/ daily service to the SF Ferry Building free w/ your monthly transportation pass. Secured garage parking available for purchase. All images/views are representative
